findings.mechanism: runtime.sync catches stage or switch errors and returns a reason; update logs every reason as skipped without setting failure, while hooks install discards the sync result and continues wiring.
findings.reproduction: Not executed by observer; owner focused reproduction assigned.
findings.impact: A runtime write failure can leave old/missing or partly replaced hooks while caller reports success; fresh hook installation can still write settings.
findings.next_task: Make failed runtime synchronization distinct from deliberate absent-runtime skip; prove actual update and hooks-install nonzero exits, no false synchronized/intact statement, and no new settings wiring after failure.
findings.prerequisite: isolated focused fake-host fixture; no actual host mutation

findings.mechanism: A switch can fail after earlier renames. Recovery restores only files whose previous copies exist, retains introduced files, then deletes recovery evidence. Journal contains names only; malformed journal reads are treated as absent.
findings.reproduction: Not executed by observer; owner focused reproduction assigned.
findings.impact: Coherent-old claim is unproven for introduced files or lost/corrupt recovery evidence; immediate failed switch can remain mixed while claiming old runtime intact.
findings.next_task: Use existence-aware, source-bound recovery admission. Test second-rename interruption, introduced file, malformed journal, missing old backup and concurrent target change; either verified rollback or explicit unresolved state retaining evidence. Never infer permission to delete from an absent backup.

read_only_scope: No target writes, broad collector rerun, test suites, providers, releases or host mutations. Own report only.
other_inspected_scope: R01/R02 reset and session state paths; corrected Codex observer order; no additional proven finding.
design_check_not_counted_as_finding: All runtime writers must be admitted: hooks install calls sync outside the update lock, so a correction cannot assume update.lock owns every recovery artifact. Owner notified for bounded design review.
